title_zh: 市十三届人大常委会党组第一次（扩大）会议召开
title_en: Party Group of 13th Lhasa Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds First Expanded Meeting
summary_zh: 拉萨市第十三届人大常委会党组召开第一次（扩大）会议，传达学习有关精神并研究部署人大党组工作。
summary_en: The Party Group of the 13th Lhasa Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee convened its first expanded meeting to convey relevant directives and plan the Party group's work.
